SELECT BID, BTYPE, COMPANY, DECODE(COMPANY, 'KRKORE0001', '전체', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = COMPANY)) AS COM_NAME, DECODE(ACL,'INC','자사', 'BUY','구매사', 'SEL', '판매사', 'KEP','KEP','MEB','회원전체','CST','특정회사','UST','특정사용자','ALL','전체') ACL_DIS, SUBJECT, CONTEXT, REG_USER_ID, REG_USER_NAME, REG_DATE, TO_DATE, FROM_DATE, LCOUNT, IMAGE_KEY, OPEN_FLAG FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE STATUS <>'D' AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND BTYPE = 'WM' AND OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND BID = #{st_bid} ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC , VID DESC
SELECT TEXT1 AS WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'WR01' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND CODE = #{st_user_id}
SELECT NVL(MAX(BID),0) + 1 FROM ICOMBOARD WHERE BTYPE = #{st_btype}

SELECT 'KRKORE0001' AS CODE, '전체' AS TEXT1 FROM DUAL UNION SELECT A.TEXT1 AS CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.TEXT1) AS TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 A WHERE A.TYPE = 'HUB' AND A.FLAG = 'Y'
